card.name: The word relieve before symptoms
card.fires_on: The verb "relieve" or noun "relief" when it is about easing symptoms or discomfort, usually after "to" or "help". It also fires weakly on a few other words, such as the R in SSRIs.

modes.label: Relieve/relief of symptoms
modes.description: The word relieve or relief right before symptoms, discomfort or tremor.
modes.example: administer an inhaled β-agonist to expedite the return of the FEV 1 to baseline and to<< relieve>> any discomfort the patient may experience

modes.label: R in SSRIs
modes.description: The letter R inside the abbreviation for selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors.
modes.example: including selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SS<<R>>Is) and serotonin and noradrenal
